title: Shrimp & Chickpea Creole
instructions: Build the sauté base: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 6 tablespoons butter. Add 2 small onions, 2 bell peppers, and 4 celery ribs and cook until soft, about 8 minutes. Season with 1 teaspoons kosher salt, to taste and 0.5 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper, to taste. Add 2 teaspoons garlic powder, 2 tablespoons paprika, 4 teaspoons dried thyme, 4 teaspoons dried oregano, and 2 teaspoons ground cayenne and cook until fragrant, 1–2 minutes more. Add 3 cups low-sodium broth and 4 bay leaves and bring to a boil. Lower to a simmer and cook until reduced by about 1/4, 6–8 minutes.
Build the sauce: Add 2 cans (15-oz.) whole tomatoes and cook until reduced by half, about 20 minutes.
Add the chicpeas:  Add 4 green onions, chickpeas and 4 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes more.
Add the shrimp: Toss in the shrimp, and cook until pink
Finish: Take off the heat and stir in lemon juice
